rairai

rairai is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for R package development.

Purpose

rairai equips AI coding agents with R-specific tools for navigating and investigating package code. It complements general-purpose file and shell tools with direct access to definitions, references, tests, and R documentation, reducing the ad hoc exploration needed for development tasks.

The goal is to make agent-assisted maintenance and refactoring more efficient and better informed, without requiring the agent to load or execute the package under inspection.

Design principles

  • No target-package execution: inspect files, symbols, references, namespace, and docs without loading, installing, or running the target package.
  • In-process source intelligence: served tools do not start a background analysis process.
  • AI-friendly outputs: compact and structured responses with stable fields.

Installation 

# pak::pak("tosidata/rairai") # development version
install.packages("rairai") # After CRAN release

Quick start

From the package directory you want to inspect, start the server:

Rscript -e "rairai::serve()"

Or configure your MCP client to start it for a specific package, for example:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "rairai": {
      "command": "Rscript",
      "args": ["-e", "rairai::serve(path = '/path/to/target-package')"]
    }
  }
}

The client starts the process and communicates over standard input and output; configuration schemas vary by client. Ask the client to call the MCP tool package_overview for a first look at the package (not an R function call).

Security

At the client’s request, rairai can read any directory readable by its process; the startup path is not a sandbox. File names, file contents, and canonical absolute host paths can be disclosed to the MCP client; inspected package code is not executed. Restrict filesystem access with process permissions or a container.

Tool reference

serve() is the only R namespace export. It exposes 21 public MCP tools; MCP tool names below are client calls, not exported R functions.

Tool Description
package_overview Return a compact first-look package orientation map with section-local follow-up tools.
package_dependencies Read package dependencies from DESCRIPTION.
package_files List package files for development (default scope R).
package_namespace Read exports, imported objects by package, S3 methods, and native-code declarations from NAMESPACE.
tests_for Find compact test locations that reference a symbol.
package_docs Return a compact documentation map for a package, including help topics, vignettes, NEWS, and next-tool hints.
help_search Search R help topics by name, alias, title, or concept and return compact ranked matches.
help_page Retrieve one R help page as plain text, optionally limited to selected sections.
package_vignettes List available vignettes or read a specific vignette as text.
package_news Read NEWS.md/NEWS for a package or the local package.
cran_search Search CRAN package metadata with pkgsearch ranking and return compact candidates.
cran_package Look up DESCRIPTION-like CRAN metadata for one exact package name.
r6_classes List R6 classes defined in flat R/*.[Rr] package source.
r6_class Return the full structure of a named R6 class.
r6_method Return exact source text and location for a specific R6 class method.
r6_method_references Find syntactic call sites of a named R6 method (obj$method()) and report requested target status.
symbols Find or list source symbols by query, file path, kind, and exactness.
definition Resolve a symbol name to one canonical definition; ambiguous matches return candidates.
references Resolve a symbol name and return reference locations.
function_formals Return package-local function signatures from source; external/package-qualified signatures return a clear limitation with help-tool next steps.
refactor_context Return a resolved declaration, references, export status, related tests, and next-tool hints in one call.

Architecture

  • R/serve.R resolves effective roots before tool work and registers the MCP tools.
  • PackageToolService shapes source and refactor responses for its bound root; non-default calls use separate root-bound services without changing cwd.
  • SourceIndex owns Tree-sitter-backed package-local symbols, definitions, references, and local function formals.
  • R/tool-definitions.R and the domain-specific tool modules contain LLM-facing mcplite::tool() constructors.

More help

Use help("serve", package = "rairai") for root selection and security details, and vignette("tools", package = "rairai") for the tool guide.
